sections: The Part 2 overhaul moves character progression toward equipment slots rather than individual equipment pieces. This is an unofficial English summary of the Korean developer notice.

Four new equipment types are introduced: Vambrace, Belt, Holy Relic and Seal. Accessories become part of the main equipment progression system. Holy Relic and Seal are collectively called Treasures (보구), a working translation.

Existing equipment converts automatically. Some high-end pieces receive additional item levels. The examples apply to individual weapons and armor pieces, not the character average. Sidereal weapons have separate rules.

Quality compensation is based on the highest eligible quality equipment owned for each weapon and armor slot. Sidereal weapons are excluded from standard quality compensation. Existing Artisan’s Energy carries over to its corresponding slot. Exact exchange rates remain unverified.
Sidereal weapons have separate item-level conversion and material refund rules. Refunded materials are described as character-bound. Selected examples only.

Qualifying accessories receive Mana Infusion Scrolls in six grades and retain their existing trade limits. H/M/L means High/Mid/Low roll. For Ancient accessories, quality must be at least 67 and effects must be eligible; the third effect only matters for H/H/H or H/H/M combinations. Qualifying Relic support necklaces and rings with H/H also receive grade 5. For bracelets, the highest-performing eligible rolled or partially rolled T4 bracelet on each character converts to a Seal Mana Infusion Scroll (grade 1–21, with grade 1 the strongest). The game evaluates DPS and support effect combinations and selects the better result, except DPS classes cannot transfer a bracelet containing only support options. Relic bracelets are assessed using Ancient-equivalent values. All other T4 bracelets, including unrolled ones, convert to dismantling materials exchangeable for silver. T3 bracelets are removed without compensation. The published November 25 notice gives effect tiers, not a complete scoring formula or exact grade cutoffs. Even within one tier, effects and roll strengths can differ.
Grade 2 (Max HP third effect) / Grade 3 (party shield or healing third effect)
Dual effects: crit rate + damage on crit; crit damage + damage on crit; additional damage + demon/archdemon damage; longer cooldown + damage to foes; damage to foes + damage to staggered foes.
Single damage effects: non-positional skill damage, back attack damage, head attack damage, additional damage, damage to foes, crit damage, crit rate.
Weapon attack power with additional bonus at ≥50% HP; weapon attack power with periodic 120-second bonus every 30 seconds.
Flat weapon attack power; stacking weapon attack power on hit with attack/move speed.

Enemy defense reduction + Ally Attack Power Enhancement Effect; enemy crit resistance reduction + Ally Attack Power Enhancement Effect; enemy crit-damage resistance reduction + Ally Attack Power Enhancement Effect; damage bonus for shielded/protected allies + Ally Attack Power Enhancement Effect.

Enemy defense reduction + Ally Attack Power Enhancement Effect; enemy crit resistance reduction + Ally Attack Power Enhancement Effect; enemy crit-damage resistance reduction + Ally Attack Power Enhancement Effect; damage bonus for shielded/protected allies + Ally Attack Power Enhancement Effect.
Specialization, Swiftness, Ally Damage Enhancement Effect, Ally Attack Power Enhancement Effect.
Weapon attack power with additional bonus at ≥50% HP; weapon attack power with periodic 120-second bonus every 30 seconds.
Flat weapon attack power; stacking weapon attack power on hit with attack/move speed.
Which bracelets should I roll before Part 2?
Ancient T4 bracelet with two combat-stat lines (any pair of Crit / Spec / Swift) plus three open effect lines. Roll useful high-tier effects; do not discard a strong existing bracelet.
Ancient T4 bracelet with Specialization + Swiftness and three open effect lines. Favor Tier 1 support dual effects, then ally-buff effectiveness.
Existing Relic or partially rolled T4 bracelets with strong stats and effects; compare before spending heavily. A strong Relic can qualify.

Three open lines are a practical target, not a conversion requirement or guaranteed high scroll grade. Only the best eligible bracelet per character yields a scroll. Avoid expensive speculative purchases before Western rules are announced.

Ability stones are removed and replaced with Engraving Slot Upgrades. Relic becomes the base engraving rarity. The conversion uses effective activation points, not raw faceting numbers. Both positive engravings must qualify for the character’s permitted DPS or support combinations. Negative effects do not affect conversion. A 4+4 stone also grants extra items. The valid engraving lists and transfer criteria below are transcribed from the supplied English reference image. The activation-point totals are not the raw faceting numbers, and the reference does not identify the additional item awarded for 4+4. Check the applicable engraving list before investing in a stone; an otherwise high-point stone is not automatically eligible.
Valid engravings for Ability Stone transfer

Awakening, Master Brawler, Ambush Master, Master’s Tenacity, Raid Captain, MP Efficiency Increase, Barricade, Broken Bone, All-Out Attack, Super Charge, Sight Focus, Adrenaline, Stabilized Status, Disrespect, Ether Predator, Keen Blunt Weapon, Grudge, Cursed Doll, Precise Dagger, Mass Increase, Propulsion, Hit Master
Awakening, Drops of Ether, Vital Point Hit, Magick Stream, Crushing Fist, Crisis Evasion, Expert, Spirit Absorption, Heavy Armor, Max MP Increase, Explosive Expert
Engraving Slot Upgrade level by activation point total
5 engraving slots set to level 7, plus an additional item

Tradable gems become roster-shared, with simultaneous use by multiple characters. Character-bound gems remain restricted. A new higher-tier gem, provisionally called Sacred Radiance Gem, is introduced above T4 level 10. Three T4 level 10 gems make the first Sacred Radiance gem, then two same-level gems make the next level. Maximum level is not specified. Important exception: qualifying T4 level 8 Radiance Gems obtained through previous paid growth events/products or Paradise content are converted into a selection box instead of the standard same-level conversion. Choose one new non-tradable T4 level 8 gem or one new tradable T4 level 7 gem. Choosing the tradable level 7 option allows you to trade it or use it for gem fusion. This exception applies only to gems from the specified acquisition routes, not every level 8 gem.

Prowess increases damage and allied attack-power buffs. Combat stats become freely assignable through Ark Passive, which unlocks at combat level 50. Cards no longer need to be manually equipped; similar effects do not stack and the strongest applies.
After all six designated characters have earned their weekly gold rewards, additional characters can earn Character-bound Gold from end content.

Trade Skills, sailing, stronghold, pets, and the player economy are being simplified. Direct player-to-player item trading uses a trust system, with additional Pheon fees possible for insufficient trust.
12. What to do before Part 2 launches

Use this checklist for each character and your roster before the Part 2 maintenance. The November 25 Korean notice recommends using or exchanging items that would otherwise disappear or lose their current use. The bracelet priorities below are practical advice, not a guaranteed scroll grade. Verify Western implementation and timing before spending gold or making irreversible decisions. Progress is saved locally in this browser.
Interpretation, not an official promise. The overall direction appears to be consolidating character power into slots and reducing the cost and complexity of maintaining alts.
Shared gems and additional bound gold
New potentially expensive gem progression ceiling
tasks: Exchange eligible leftover T3 honing materials (destruction/guardian stones, leapstones, etc.) at the Honing Material Exchange NPC for T4 materials before maintenance. Honor Shards and shard pouches convert to silver instead.
Fuse leftover T3 damage and cooldown gems at Lv. 1–2 up to at least Lv. 3 before maintenance; otherwise they are deleted without replacement.

Check every character's T4 bracelets. Prioritize Ancient bracelets with any two of Crit / Spec / Swift + 3 open roll lines (DPS), or Spec + Swift + 3 open lines (support). Roll promising unrolled bracelets; compare against your current best using the Section 6 tier tables. Relic and partially rolled bracelets may also qualify. Keep your strongest eligible bracelet until conversion; only one scroll per character.
Use Aura of Resonance recovery potions and consume existing Aura of Resonance through eligible content before maintenance. Remaining aura and recovery potions are deleted, not compensated.
Use Rest Bonus recovery potions and consume existing rest bonus by running eligible daily content before maintenance. Old rest bonus and recovery potions do not carry over.
Spend all Sand of Trials by running the Haal’s Haal’s Hourglass content before maintenance; unused sand is deleted without replacement.

Guild officers: distribute the guild's remaining guild Bloodstones to members before maintenance. Undistributed guild Bloodstones disappear; character-held Sylmael Bloodstones convert to silver at an announced rate.
Apply any unused Jumping Growth / Powerpass style support to the intended character before maintenance; the style-support feature ends.

systems: Multi-crit (p. 2)

At over 100% crit chance, every eligible attack crits and the excess chance determines an additional crit. Each extra crit adds the damage gained from the original crit, excluding base damage. The same rule extends beyond 200% and 300% crit chance. On-crit effects trigger only once per hit.
Example (p. 2)
120% crit rate, 250% crit damage: 80% of attacks deal 250% base damage and 20% deal 400%. Paradise does not use multi-crit because its legacy effects already increase damage according to crit rate.
High-crit tripods (p. 2)
Selected PvE tripod crit-rate bonuses exceeding 80% were adjusted to 80%.
Combat analysis (p. 2)

Character information now displays crit rates above 100%. Crit-rate and crit-damage tooltips explain multi-crit. Combat analysis shows multi-crit hit rate and damage share in real time and per skill; multi-crits also remain included in the ordinary crit statistics.
Blunt Thorn (p. 2)

Evolution damage 7.5/15% → 9.5/19%; excess crit conversion 125/150% → 120/140%; former node-specific Evolution damage cap of 52.5/75% removed. Crit chance still capped at 80%, and multi-crit does not apply while Blunt Thorn is active.
November 19 follow-up (separate secondary source)

All Minute Hand skills, including Ark Passive and Super Awakening skills, and Dimension Slash Awakening damage −5%. Ark Grid — Distorted Timeline Sun core 17P: Dimension Rift damage bonus 10/13.5% → 3/6.5%; 5s cooldown reduction per Destiny activation unchanged. (p. 11; English names provisional)

balanceArchive.title: October 3 · Emergency PvE balance pass
balanceArchive.description: Official Korean emergency maintenance notice, October 3, 2026 (notice 13561). The supplied three-page print PDF directly confirms 19 combat-style PvE damage buffs. Two rows between pages 1 and 2 are not visible in the printout; the previously listed Perfect Suppression and Night’s Edge values remain secondary-source cross-references, not directly PDF-verified. Maintenance ended at 06:50 Korean time.
systems: Mordum Extreme Nightmare
HP reduced for the Act 3 Kazeros Raid boss Mordum on Extreme Nightmare difficulty. The notice does not specify the reduction percentage. (PDF p. 1)
Clear compensation

Rosters with a recorded Extreme Nightmare clear before the October 3 emergency maintenance received a gold-bar item in the universal storage of the character with the clear. Using it grants 500,000 Character-bound Gold. (PDF p. 2)
Entry compensation

Rosters that entered Act 3 Extreme Nightmare at least once between September 23 and the publication of the Director’s Letter on October 2 at 19:05 received 30 Splendid Battle Item Selection Chests in universal storage. (PDF p. 2; item name provisional)
